note.note:
Please provide the following:

1) The transcript of the patient encounter (doctor–patient dialogue).
2) The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) in JSON format.

Once provided, I will generate the structured Problem List Clinical Note with:
- Consult Summary (two-line overview)
- Problem List (Issue 1–3 as applicable, with brief descriptions, systems review, social/meds/exam findings, and consistent DDx with likelihood and justification)
- Medications
- Allergies
- Past Medical History
- Social History
- Preventative History
- Physical Examination
- Plan
- Quality checks (including notes on missing elements, any conflicts between transcript and DDx, and transcript quality)

Notes:
- Use American English, concise, professional tone.
- Only include information present in the transcript or DDx.
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, record the name and append “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- If transcript and DDx conflict, include both and mark “conflict noted.”
